ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……非常感谢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: Mortis。我，毋畏死亡

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 爽世她……不知该如何是好了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
（不能失败……不许退缩——
哈啊……哈啊……）

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 『就像这样，小睦一直以来都不太会说话』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 爽世怎么办？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 是在月之森第一个组建乐队的，高中部的学姐

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 你真的要退学吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……CRYCHIC呢？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我……从没觉得玩乐队开心过

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 祥……Mortis说，她不想消失

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 你甚至不会察觉，自己陷入了沉眠

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 苦瓜浇太多水会出问题的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我从小就一直在学芭蕾

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 拿着吉他……就会觉得安心

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 猫在聚会。看来它们知道哪里暖和

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊，四叶草……这是第二个了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 若麦说阳光是最大的敌人，她把不用的遮阳伞给我了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 艺术之秋……古典乐、摇滚乐还有偶像歌曲我都会听哦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 踩在落叶上的声音，在耳边回响

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 给菜园做了防寒措施，希望能顺利度过这个冬天

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 下雪的日子，世界会变成白茫茫的一片

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 小时候，我和祥一起装饰过圣诞树

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 新年好。今年也请多关照

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 巧克力，我吃不了这么多。海铃，你吃吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 祥叫我今天早点睡

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_028
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 大家所期望的……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_029
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 谢谢大家这么多的祝福，我会努力不辜负大家的心意的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_000
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: ……非常感谢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_001
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: Mortis。我，毋畏死亡

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_002
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 爽世她……不知该如何是好了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_003
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
（不能失败……不许退缩——
哈啊……哈啊……）

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_004
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 『就像这样，小睦一直以来都不太会说话』

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_007
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 爽世怎么办？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_008
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 是在月之森第一个组建乐队的，高中部的学姐

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 你真的要退学吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: ……CRYCHIC呢？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我……从没觉得玩乐队开心过

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_012
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 祥……Mortis说，她不想消失

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 你甚至不会察觉，自己陷入了沉眠

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 苦瓜浇太多水会出问题的

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我从小就一直在学芭蕾

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 拿着吉他……就会觉得安心

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 猫在聚会。看来它们知道哪里暖和

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 啊，四叶草……这是第二个了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 若麦说阳光是最大的敌人，她把不用的遮阳伞给我了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 艺术之秋……古典乐、摇滚乐还有偶像歌曲我都会听哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 踩在落叶上的声音，在耳边回响

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 给菜园做了防寒措施，希望能顺利度过这个冬天

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_023
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 下雪的日子，世界会变成白茫茫的一片

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_024
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 小时候，我和祥一起装饰过圣诞树

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_025
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 新年好。今年也请多关照

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_026
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 巧克力，我吃不了这么多。海铃，你吃吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_027
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 祥叫我今天早点睡

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_028
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 大家所期望的……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_029
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 谢谢大家这么多的祝福，我会努力不辜负大家的心意的
